items.title: Chasen Matcha Bar weekly pop-up
items.description: Chasen pops up every Wednesday and Thursday morning for a midweek matcha stop at 2001 S. Ervay St in Dallas.
items.notes: Tavily snippet quotes "every Wednesday & Thursday from 9 AM-1 PM, 2001 S. Ervay St"; post not opened, post date unknown so the recurrence is inferred for this Wednesday; ma.to venue page lists no dates. checked 2026-11-23: ma.to venue page says "No dates announced right now"; a Nov 19 DFW roundup lists 2001 S Ervay under Mo Matcha (9am-1pm), so the brand at that address is unclear; brand page not reachable.

items.title: Mori Matcha at 1 Hotel on Rainey (Mondays)
items.description: Mori Matcha, an Austin matcha pop-up, serves at the new 1 Hotel on Rainey on Mondays, per a creator post; the pop-up schedule changes so check their Instagram.
items.notes: Tavily snippet from a creator post: found at the new 1 Hotel on Rainey on Mondays; start time and street number not stated, time is a placeholder, Monday recurrence inferred for this date; post not opened. checked 2026-11-23: several Instagram/TikTok snippets repeat "Mori Matcha Mondays run every week" at 1 Hotel Austin (Neighbors cafe, 96 Red River St), but no brand page or hours were reachable.

items.title: Tala Matcha pop-up at Offline Tulsa Collective
items.description: Tala Matcha serves matcha at Offline Tulsa Collective, a vintage shop in the Pearl District, in recurring Sunday pop-ups.
items.notes: Tavily snippet: "matcha pop up this Sunday at offlinetulsacollective, 11am-3pm"; post date not shown, so which Sunday is inferred (may be Nov 22, before the window); Offline Collective address 1321 E 6th St from a second snippet; post not opened. checked 2026-11-23: Tala posts Offline Collective Sundays (Nov 8 12-4pm; a later post says Sunday 11am-4pm) but no page gives a Nov 29 date; brand page not reachable.
